due_when.clears_when: A vm-diag snapshot from ict-bot-arm shows a health check named `strategy_roster` with ctx.state == 'ok' and ctx.resolved == ctx.declared. That single observation establishes all three facts at once: the code is on the VM (the check exists at all), the process that runs the checks has restarted onto it, and the roster is actually readable there. [!] A snapshot whose checks list has 7 entries and no `strategy_roster` is NOT evidence of anything except that the deploy has not landed -- do not read it as a pass. [!] AND IT DOES NOT COVER THE EXIT HALF: the health check runs in the web-api/report process; `exit_population` runs in ict-trader-live. The second, separate observation is a `[diag-request] journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&lines=500` showing either the E21 off-roster warning line or, at minimum, a trader restart timestamp later than the deploy commit.

what: E21's exit-path fix is MERGED-only until a live snapshot shows it. The change (branch e21-exit-monitor-roster-resolution) deletes pipeline.py's hardcoded ['turtle_soup','vwap'] roster fallback, makes the exit tick's population open-packages UNION the roster (order_monitor.exit_population), and adds the health check `strategy_roster`. MEASURED 2026-09-22 by parsing config/strategies.yaml (55 declared) + config/accounts.yaml (11 accounts) at f3746ab: 52 distinct strategies are routed to at least one `mode: live` account and the deleted fallback covered 0 of them. [!] WHAT IS NOT YET ESTABLISHED, and is the whole point of this row: the live trader is a long-running process whose `STRATEGIES` is evaluated ONCE at import, so NONE of this reaches production until ict-trader-live is RESTARTED after the deploy. ict-git-sync pulls main every ~5 min but does not restart the trader. So `merged` will be true and `deployed` false for an unbounded window, and `observed` needs a third fact on top of that.
why_it_matters: The defect being fixed is an exit-path outage on a live real-money system that presents as `7/7 checks ok`. A fix for a silent failure that is itself unobserved reproduces the same condition one level up -- this repo's most-paid-for mistake is collapsing merged / deployed / observed.
